text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! What the hell? His body's crackling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおっ！？　
何だあ？
あいつの体、
バチバチいってやがる！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: It seems to be accumulating the power of lightning. If we don't stop it soon, we'll be electrocuted... We'll all be wiped out in one hit. We have to get in his way somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
雷の力を溜めているようです。
はやく止めないと、
感電必至……
一撃で全滅ですわ。
何とかして
奴の邪魔をしなければ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: You're in the way... Hmm? From what I can tell, he's building up his strength while using a big technique.
text_block_list.orig_text:
邪魔ねえ……
んー？
見る感じ、
あいつは大技を使いながら力を溜めてるな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: In other words, why don’t we just get in his way so he can’t use his big move?
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
あいつが大技を使えないように
妨害してやりゃあいいんじゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Understood. It's a pain to do some petty tricks, but let's do as you say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかりましたわ。
小細工は面倒ですが、
ここはあなたの言う通りにしましょう。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Oh, you wanna ride? That's great! Then let's get started on Operation Great Technique Interference!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
乗るってか？　
いいねえ！
んじゃあ
『大技妨害作戦』──
始めるとしようぜっ！
